description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Halo Fountain to become a creature.
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Heronblade Elite, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Heronblade Elite
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater
